name: What is embodied carbon, and why does it matter?

mainEntity.name: What is embodied carbon, and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Embodied carbon is the greenhouse gas emissions from material production, transport, and construction; green building minimizes it through material substitution and waste reduction. inogenalliance​
